_meta.description: Facet of region on the customers aged 50 and over (FILTER_RANGE on age) decorated with an OVERLAY_CHISQ_VS_POP scalar overlay: a chi-square goodness-of-fit test of the subset's region counts against the whole cohort's region shares (chi-square about 4.0 on 3 df, p about 0.26 here: the older customers spread over the regions like everyone else). ref.population.cohort names the comparison cohort as a path resolved from the working directory (it takes no data_dir, so run from the repo root). The layer summary carries statistic, p_value and parameters.df; any expected count below 5 emits one PULSE_OVERLAY_EXPECTED_LOW. Discrete-field siblings: OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_POP (10_facet_index_vs_pop.json) and OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_POP (21_facet_zscore_vs_pop.json). Buffered.
_meta.name: facet-chisq-vs-pop
